question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Do you think Howard and $ZOE should stay together?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Oh yeah. I'm going out with a bang. This is going to be the high school party to end all high school parties...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: The Best Party Ever, Ever, For All Time, Ever, For Reals!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Hee hee!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Am I gonna see you there, man?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah. Probably. I think.
At the front of the stage, Principal Shapiro taps the mic...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Graduation is a time to look back. To reflect on what has come before. To consider the many choices we made that got us to this point... And to say goodbye to what we will be leaving behind.
$Scott and Angie look at each other uncomfortably...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What? What's wrong? What did I say?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Well... I don't really wanna tell you how to live your life, man... But that's really not a great attitude to have.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: A long-distance relationship is a `ton` of work. You can't just 'give it a try.' You have to be really committed to it.
nodes.text_bbcode: A long-distance relationship is a [color=#3b78e2][i]ton[/i][/color] of work. You can't just 'give it a try.' You have to be really committed to it.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: If you're not one hundred percent sure that she's the one, then you don't want to put yourself through that.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, guys, I get it.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Sorry... It's just something we put a lot of thought into.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I can tell.
An awkward silence hangs in the air...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: So... Listen... I'm throwing a party tonight...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Wow... You really believe that, huh?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, I do. $ZOE's my true love. She's the person I'm meant to be with. Nothing can stand in the way of that.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: That's so romantic...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Good for you, man. Good for you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Heh... Thanks, guys.
Suddenly, Howard thinks back... His words sound awfully familiar...
Two years ago, in Brendan's den...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You sure you'll make it work?

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Of course! Dinah's my true love! She's the person I'm meant to be with. Nothing can stand in the way of that!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeesh.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: What's wrong, Howard?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Nothing... Don't worry about it.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: So... Listen... I'm throwing a party tonight...
Howard's mom calls from the kitchen.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Howard! Are you going to come have your breakfast?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'll be right there, Mom. I just need to get ready for school.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...My last day of high school. Ever.
That day, Howard walks through the school, looking around wistfully...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Aw... There's the nook between two lockers where $ZOE and I would always make out...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And that table in the library where I'd always cram for finals...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And the water fountain where I always...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Got water...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess that's not really much of a memory...
Just then, Erik runs up to the fountain and drinks!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Mm-mmm! So crisp and refreshing! Every time I drink from you, Freddy Fountain, I feel like I'm making memories for life!
Erik scampers off.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sigh...
Just then, someone gives Howard a gentle kiss on the cheek!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hi, Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...Hey.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Nothing, nothing. I'm just... I'm kind of bummed, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Time just moves so fast, you know?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Howard, I...
$ZOE's interrupted by the door to the auditorium flying open! Principal Shapiro pops out!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ah!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Howard! There you are! I've been looking all over for you!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You have?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Yes! We have graduation rehearsal!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Aw man! I totally forgot about that!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you okay, Howard? That's not like you...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm... I'm fine, $ZOE. Don't worry about it.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Then come on!
Howard follows Shapiro into the gym where all the seniors are assembled. Howard takes his place in line...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Hey, Howard. Rough night? You look exhausted.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, I couldn't sleep well. I kept having all these weird dreams...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It wasn't me this time, I swear! I didn't use my dream machine!
Everyone turns to stare at Angie.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I mean... What dream machine?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...I think I'm just stressed about graduation. I mean, it's just hard thinking about saying goodbye to everything, you know?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You're going to Centerscore U, right? That's not too far way. You're not `really` saying goodbye...
nodes.text_bbcode: You're going to Centerscore U, right? That's not too far way. You're not [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] saying goodbye...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah, I guess. What are you guys doing?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I'm going to Kingston University in New York!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh... Great...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: And I'll be traveling across America in my RV! It's gonna be awesome!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, that does sound pretty good...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But it'll be real tough making your relationship work, right?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Actually, Howard... We're breaking up at the end of the summer.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait, `what?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait, [color=#e23b3b][i]what?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But... But you guys seem so happy!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: We are happy! That's why we're breaking up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That doesn't make any sense.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Am I still dreaming? Because there better not be another giant Officer Monte...
Scott pats Howard on the shoulder...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Look, man. Have you ever seen someone try to do a long-distance relationship? It's `brutal` stuff.
nodes.text_bbcode: Look, man. Have you ever seen someone try to do a long-distance relationship? It's [color=#e23b3b][i]brutal[/i][/color] stuff.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I watched Brendan go through it. It was the worst six months of his life.

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: We don't want to put ourselves through that. We don't want our relationship to go down in a flaming mess of tears, accusations, and miscommunicated text messages.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's `oddly` specific...
nodes.text_bbcode: That's [color=#e23b3b][i]oddly[/i][/color] specific...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: ...Brendan talks about it a lot.
$Scott wraps his arm around Angie's shoulder...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Dating Anj has been amazing... And that's how I want to remember our relationship.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Plus, we'll stay best friends!

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: Of course!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wow... I... That's just... A whole other way of looking at it, I guess...

nodes.speaker: Scott
nodes.text: I take it you and $ZOE are gonna try to make it work?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, yeah...

options.label: We're gonna give it a try.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I mean, I get that you're sentimental, but we've `talked` about the constant pranking...
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, I get that you're sentimental, but we've [color=#e23b3b][i]talked[/i][/color] about the constant pranking...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: It's not that bad!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You've been kicked out of seven elementary schools!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Technically only six!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We burnt down the seventh!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Is that supposed to help your case?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Please, Howard? Just a few more pranks? `Please...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Please, Howard? Just a few more pranks? [color=#3b78e2][i]Please...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Howard takes the backpacks.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No can do, girls. What kind of a big brother would I be if I let you get in trouble on your last day of school?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: An awesome one!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Instead of a big, dumb stupid-head!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah! We hate you! We loathe you! We despise you!
The twins run off, crying!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And I want my thesaurus back!
Howard looks down at their backpacks and sighs...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Maybe I was a little harsh... I could have been nicer...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: One last great memory on their last day... I guess I can relate to wanting that.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: You're not mad?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, I'm a little mad. But I kind of see where you're coming from.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I guess I can relate.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Aw... Are you sad it's your last day of high school?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well... A little...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Aren't you excited about college?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Yeah! We saw on a show that it's all goofing off and having fun and hot tub toga parties!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `And` we're restricting your TV privileges.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]And[/i][/color] we're restricting your TV privileges.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Triple dang!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But... I have to admit... I can see why you'd want one last great memory on your last day of school.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: So... Can we keep our backpacks?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You can have the crawdads and the shaving cream. I'm keeping the fireworks and the bomb variety pack.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Deal!
Howard hands the twins the shaving cream and crawdads and sends them on their way.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It's kind of weird... But I hope they have fun.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Not too much...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But a little.
And lands back on the football field!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: For real? This again?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Tell me I don't have to deal with any vampires...
Howard looks around... And sees the cheerleaders hanging out. Sam talks to someone...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just... I just really, `really` want this spot on the cheerleading team.
nodes.text_bbcode: I just... I just really, [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] want this spot on the cheerleading team.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I can't let anything... Or `anyone` get in my way.
nodes.text_bbcode: And I can't let anything... Or [color=#3b78e2][i]anyone[/i][/color] get in my way.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I understand.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE! That's who I was forgetting about! Of course!
Howard rushes over...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $ZOE! There you are! I've been looking for you all... Well, all of whatever this is!
$ZOE turns to Howard...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, do I know you?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh! Right! This is the day we met!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm Howard... And you and I have some amazing times ahead of us!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We... We do?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You don't know this yet... But you're the love of my life.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I am?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You are. You really, `really` are.
nodes.text_bbcode: You are. You really, [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] are.

nodes.text: Howard leans forward to kiss $ZOE... Everything seems to move in fast motion...
And they stand in $ZOE's house!
Snow falls outside, a real tree laden with ornaments stands in the corner, and a small present lies beneath it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh! I know this! It's that Christmas where I got you a tree!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That was nice, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It was `perfect!
Howard kisses $ZOE again...
And they twirl together at Prom!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And this was our perfect Prom!
$ZOE wraps her arms around Howard's neck...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I love you, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I love you too, $ZOE! So, `so,` much!
nodes.text_bbcode: I love you too, $ZOE! So, [color=#e23b3b][i]so,[/i][/color] much!

nodes.text: Howard leans in to kiss her...
And feels a cold wind on his neck! He looks around to find himself on the Eiffel Tower!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And this is when I got you back in Paris! I was so worried about you...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You thought you'd lost me...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I didn't. We got back together!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...For now.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I mean... Everything ends, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Everything ends.
And suddenly, Howard is holding only air. A flock of ducks flies away, vanishing into the night.
Howard wakes up with a start. He lies in bed quietly for a moment...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That was... One heck of a dream...
And wakes up with a start!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hff... Hff... Man, that was one weird dream...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I kind of wish I hadn't woken up. I feel like there was a lot more to it than that...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But I guess there's nothing I can really do.
Just then, the smell of bacon catches Howard's nose...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh, no way...
Howard rushes into the kitchen where a full breakfast is laid out!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Awesome!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Good morning, Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Is that...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Blueberry pancakes... Italian sausage omelet... And fresh maple bacon... Your favorite breakfast!
Howard gives his mom a hug!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is amazing! Why'd you make it?

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Well, it `is` your last day of high school... I just wanted you to enjoy it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, it [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] your last day of high school... I just wanted you to enjoy it!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Now have some bacon! You're a growing boy!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Mom, I haven't been `growing` since sixth grade....
nodes.text_bbcode: Mom, I haven't been [color=#e23b3b][i]growing[/i][/color] since sixth grade....

nodes.text: Just then, Kay and Kel rush by!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Bye, Mom and Howard!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Have a nice day!
The twins race by as quickly as they can. Howard looks at his mom. She sighs and nods. He rushes after the twins...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey! Devil-spawn! Stop right there!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Us?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Whatever do you want, dear brother?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Surely you're not accusing us of malfeasance!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: First off, thanks for confirming that you stole my thesaurus.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Dang!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And second, you know the rules. No leaving the house without a backpack inspection.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Double dang!
Howard pulls open the twins' backpacks...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Let's see...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We've got firecrackers...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Shaving cream...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Smoke bombs... Stink bombs... Something called a 'bee bomb', I don't really know how that works...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And... Is this a bag full of crawdads?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We plead the fifth?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Come on, you two. You know there's no way I can let you go to school with that stuff!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: But... But...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But what?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: But it's our last day of fourth grade!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: So?

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: So we need to go out with a bang!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Literally!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: Not helping, Kay.

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: We just... We had such a good time in fourth grade... We really want to end it on a perfect note... One last grand finale, you know?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Girls, that's...
Score Up!

Howard hurls his hands up in front of his face...

And lands on some grass at a raging outdoor party!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is... Different...
On the stage, Hector, Brendan, and Spike are all singing in Chinese!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That's `really` different...
nodes.text_bbcode: That's [color=#e23b3b][i]really[/i][/color] different...

nodes.text: Someone grabs Howard's hand! He turns around and finds himself face-to-face with Linda!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh! Hey, Linda! Long time no see!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What are you talking about? You saw me just a few minutes ago! We kissed after you sang that `beautiful` song!
nodes.text_bbcode: What are you talking about? You saw me just a few minutes ago! We kissed after you sang that [color=#3b78e2][i]beautiful[/i][/color] song!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh... Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I was totally emasculated, bro. You're `way` more of a man than I am.
nodes.text_bbcode: I was totally emasculated, bro. You're [color=#e23b3b][i]way[/i][/color] more of a man than I am.

nodes.speaker: Kenji

nodes.speaker: Linda

Kenji waddles off.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Heh... `That` guy, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: Heh... [color=#e23b3b][i]That[/i][/color] guy, right?

nodes.text: Linda lunges forward, wrapping her arms around Howard's waist...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Whoa...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What's wrong? Don't you want to kiss me?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It just... Feels like I'm forgetting someone...
A duck quacks somewhere far away...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Someone important...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What could be more important than kissing me? Come on!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, I... I guess...
Howard leans forward and kisses Linda...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Mmmm...
Howard pulls away!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I... I don't know, but... This just isn't right!
Howard runs away from Linda...
Through some thick trees!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh man, this is gonna be an ordeal, isn't it?
Brendan and Hector come running up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hey, guys...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: No time to talk, Howard! Run!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Officer Monte's on our tail!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh! I know this one! This is when we broke out of Boot Camp, right?
The ground behind them explodes, and a giant Officer Monte bursts out!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: `BOW BEFORE MY WRATH, PUNY MORTALS!`

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I was wrong! I don't remember that!
The gigantic Officer Monte looms over them! He scoops up Brendan in one hand and pops him in his mouth!

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Nooooooooooo!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ahhh! This just got really dark!
Giant Monte grabs up Hector...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No! Don't eat him!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sorry, dogg! It's been real!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I'm glad we got to spend the time we had together! I...
Hector is silenced as he vanishes down Monte's gullet!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hector! No!
Giant Monte looms over Howard!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: `I AM ALLEGORICAL!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I AM ALLEGORICAL![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I don't really know what that means! Please don't eat me!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: `THEN TELL ME! WHO BROKE YOU OUT OF BOOT CAMP?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]THEN TELL ME! WHO BROKE YOU OUT OF BOOT CAMP?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait... `Wait...` I know this!
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait... [color=#e23b3b][i]Wait...[/i][/color] I know this!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It was...

nodes.text: Well, yeah! I remember this like it was yesterday!
Hector pulls open his backpack. The twins sit inside!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay, that's just creepy...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: `Bad twins!` Bad! No stealing high-end designer electronics!

nodes.speaker: Kay

nodes.text: We just thought it would be fun to do... Before we run out of time...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait, what?

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: You see... Soon enough... We'll be all grown up...

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: And then this will all be in the past...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: Everything ends, Howard. Everything.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Wow. That got melancholy in a hurry.
The twins reach out! They grab Howard's arms!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ahhhh!
They pull him down into the backpack! He tumbles into darkness...

Hector comes sprinting up!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yo! Dogg!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hector! Do you know what's going on, man? A minute ago I was playing football...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: No time for football! We need to find my MusicBoxx!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Your what?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: My MusicBoxx! We need it to throw the `best party ever!`
nodes.text_bbcode: My MusicBoxx! We need it to throw the [color=#e23b3b][i]best party ever![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Honest question... How many `Best Party Ever`s can there really be?
nodes.text_bbcode: Honest question... How many [color=#e23b3b][i]Best Party Ever[/i][/color]s can there really be?

nodes.text: Hector slaps Howard across the face!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ow! Since when do you slap me?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Since you suddenly went crazy! You're the one who was obsessed with that MusicBoxx, remember? It's got that song for Linda!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...Linda?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Uh, yeah? The girl you're `so` into? Your one, true love?
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, yeah? The girl you're [color=#e23b3b][i]so[/i][/color] into? Your one, true love?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That doesn't seem right...
Hector slaps Howard again!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Okay! Seriously! Stop that!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Then help me find the MusicBoxx!

nodes.speaker: Howard

nodes.text: Yes! Perfect meat-toss, meat! Meat meat meat!

And turns into a duck! With a quack, it flies through the goalposts!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Yes! Duck-down! We win the game!

Howard races across the parking lot as fast as he can...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Come on, come on...
Effortlessly, he makes it to the van, jerks open the door, and dives in!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yes!
Howard turns around! Ben has caught up with him, but Hector is lagging behind!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Hfff... Hfff... Shouldn't have eaten... All that string cheese...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: You're not getting away from us!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh no!
The Wilson guys have almost gotten to Hector...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Don't worry... I got this!
Howard opens his backpack and pulls out a small package wrapped in duct tape! He winds up and hurls it with all his strength!
It flies over Hector's head...
And lands right in front of the Wilson guys!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: What the...
The parcel bursts open... And a swarm of bees flies out!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Ahhhh!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Run!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Rabid insects! Rabid insects!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Heh... `Bee bomb!` I love it!

nodes.text: Howard runs as fast as he can...
But his legs betray him, and he sprawls out on the asphalt!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `Crap!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Crap![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Hector and Ben run ahead and make it to the van! The Wilson guys crowd around Howard!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Go on without me, guys! Get out of here!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No! Leave no man behind!
Ben reaches into his backpack and pulls out a glass jar! He hurls it towards Howard...
Where it explodes in a cloud of thick, green smoke!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That's right! Smoke bomb!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Awesome!
In the thick haze, Howard pulls himself up and runs away...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Where is he? Find him!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: I got him!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: That's me, idiot!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Oh... Really? Man, you've got some rock-hard abs...

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: What is `wrong` with you, Steve?
nodes.text_bbcode: What is [color=#e23b3b][i]wrong[/i][/color] with you, Steve?

nodes.text: Howard bursts out of the smoke cloud and dives into the van!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Thanks, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Of course! It was nothing!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well... Except 50 dollars worth of chemicals, I guess...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You guys done accounting? Because I think it's time to go!
He hits the gas and drives off. The shouts of the furious Wilson students vanish into the distance...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Now!
Howard releases his lizards...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What?! No! Too soon!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: What are you doing!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oops!
Howard dives to catch his lizards...
And ends up only knocking over the stand he's hiding behind!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Double oops!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Abort! Abort!
Ben and Hector run away! Everyone in the room turns to stare at Howard, who has a pile of baby lizards at his feet...
There's a scream from the far side of the room as Hector and Ben release their lizards!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yes! We did it! Run!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Wait! I... I didn't have time to...
It's too late! All of the people attending graduation scream and lunge away, as lizards scurry underfoot. Hector and Ben run away...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No! Wait!
Howard fumbles with his bag of lizards...
And knocks over the stand he's hiding behind! Everyone in the room turns to stare at him...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: What... Is... `This?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What... Is... [color=#e23b3b][i]This?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: A... Comical misunderstanding?
Two hours later, at the police station...
Howard's family arrives to pick him up!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Tell me, Officer... How bad is it?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Oh, it's plenty bad, ma'am. He's facing two charges of trespassing and seven charges of unlawful mischief with newborn reptiles.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: If I had my way, he'd be spending the rest of his life in the big house!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Just so I'm clear, when you say the 'big house,' are you referring to a mansion? An estate of sorts?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I'm referring to prison.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Okay. Cool. Got it. Just making sure.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Unfortunately, I don't get to choose the sentence... So I'm thinking the worst he'll get is a fee of $50,000.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I know! Talk about an outrage! Might as well let all the criminals go scot-free!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Speaking of which...
Howard shuffles out of his jail cell.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...Hi, guys.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Oh, Howard. I'm `so` disappointed in you!
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, Howard. I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] disappointed in you!

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Seriously! For a moment, I thought you might get to live in a mansion, and I was excited, but now I'm back to being disappointed!

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: I'd expect this from the twins... But not you!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm so sorry... I... I don't know what I was thinking...
Kay and Kel rush out from behind their mother's back...

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: `We` don't know what you were thinking!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]We[/i][/color] don't know what you were thinking!

nodes.speaker: Kel
nodes.text: How could you get caught on such a basic prank! I mean, talk about an amateur!

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: We're ashamed to call you our big brother!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Guys, I... I know it was a bad idea, but... I just wanted to have one last memory at Twin Branches before I left for Centerscore U...

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Well, unfortunately, I think that's off the table now. After we pay off your fine, we won't be able to afford your tuition.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But... But...

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Sorry, kid. You messed up.

nodes.speaker: Kay
nodes.text: `Big time!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Big time![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Wow! Talk about a terrible ending! We know you can do better than that!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Now!
Howard, Hector and Ben release their lizards at the same time!
As the graduation caps come crashing down, everyone starts screaming!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Something's on my feet!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: The room's full of lizards!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Rabid reptiles! Rabid reptiles!
The room erupts in confusion and chaos! Everyone yells, runs, and scrambles!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Mission accomplished! Go go `go!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Mission accomplished! Go go [color=#e23b3b][i]go![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Howard bolts away! He bursts out the front door into the parking lot.
Ben and Hector rush out of the side doors!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Go! Run for my van!
Howard looks across the parking lot... And sees the van at the far end!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why did we park so far away?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It made sense at the time!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Did it, Hector? `Did it?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Did it, Hector? [color=#e23b3b][i]Did it?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Behind them, the doors of the auditorium fly open, and Wilson students rush out! Alexei wriggles, kicking a lizard out of his pant leg, and screams...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: After them!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: `Run!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Run![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Not yet!
Just then, Howard's phone beeps! He glances down to see a text from $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Text
nodes.text: 'Hey Howard. What's going on? Haven't seen you all day. Love you!'

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Talk about bad timing!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Happy graduation, Wilson High!
Everyone tosses their caps into the air!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Not yet... Wait for it...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: But seriously, it's been great. I don't know what I'm going to miss most... The dances... The parties... Or pranking those guys down at Centerscore High.

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Actually, I heard it's called Twin Branches now...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Steve! Seriously! You're just making things worse for yourself!
The whole room laughs again!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: For real, though, pranking them was the best. There was that one time we TP-ed their stupid fountain... That time we spray-painted their schoolbus... That time we kidnapped their lizard... Or wait, that was like `5` times!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: You think those losers would get better at hiding him away!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This feels like kind of a mean-spirited graduation speech...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What do you expect, Makeover? It's Wilson.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I'll miss all you guys so much...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Except for Steve. Steve kind of sucks. Seriously, Steve, get it together. You're not doing yourself any favors.
On stage, the principal clears his throat...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Ahem! I'd like to invite everyone to stand to their feet...
Everyone in the room rises...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How about you, Amanda? You want in?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh no, I don't do pranks anymore. I always forget who the target is...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: It's true. She TP-ed her own house three times.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Looks like it's just us guys, then! What are you thinking? Eggs? Water balloons? Maybe something with duct tape and shaving cream?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Actually... I think I have a better idea...
A few minutes later, Ben leads Hector and Howard into the biology classroom...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: All right, Ben, what's the big surprise? This better not involve learning...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh, believe me, this is worth it...
Ben crosses the room to a glass cage covered by a sheet.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ever since we switched to being the Twin Branches Squirrels, Lyle's been retired, and I've been taking care of him. And look what I discovered!
Ben pulls off the sheet...
And reveals Lyle, lounging around with a dozen baby lizards!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Turns out Lyle is a `Lyla!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Turns out Lyle is a [color=#e23b3b][i]Lyla![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How long have you been waiting to say that?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Three weeks or so.
Hector looks into the cage uneasily...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Lyle's a girl? Seriously?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I had to take care of him on cheerleading trips... I'd talk to him all the time about, you know, guy issues...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Now I just feel kind of weird and exposed!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Right. Well. The lizards are all going to get donated to the pound at the end of the summer. I was planning on secretly setting them free...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But maybe the best time to do that would be during Wilson's graduation!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I like how you think, Ben! You really are a natural at this!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Heh... Well... I guess...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: How much time do we have?
Hector checks his watch.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The graduation ends in an hour...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Then let's get pranking!
Twenty minutes later...
Howard lies on his stomach behind a stand of chairs. He holds a small bag of lizards.
Quietly, he whispers into his headset...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Renegade, this is Gladiator. Do you copy, Renegade?
On the other side of the room, hidden behind some bleachers, Hector whispers back...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Copy, Gladiator. This is Renegade. Do you copy, Makeover?
Under the stage, Ben answers...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Uh, negative, Renegade, I thought my code-name was Samurai...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sorry, Makeover, I couldn't hear you. Maybe if you got a haircut...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Quit joking around, Renegade. Stay on target.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah. We all need to release our lizards at the same time for maximum confusion and prank impact.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The sign is when everyone tosses their caps into the air. Got it?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Got it. Now shhh!
On stage, the principal of Wilson High announces the next speaker... Outgoing Student Body President Alexei!
Alexei takes the stage...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Hey, guys. It's been a pretty crazy four years, am I right? We all had a lot of memories... Good times... Bad times... Crazy times...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: That time Steve got his head stuck in a bucket and ran around screaming for two hours...
The whole room breaks into laughter...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I mean, they're `Wilson High!` Our most hated rivals! What kind of men would we be if we `didn't` stick it to them?
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, they're [color=#e23b3b][i]Wilson High![/i][/color] Our most hated rivals! What kind of men would we be if we [color=#e23b3b][i]didn't[/i][/color] stick it to them?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I dunno, man, it just doesn't feel that relevant. Things with Wilson have been pretty chill lately, you know?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Chill? What are you talking about? We never paid them back for that water attack on our 4th of July party!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Didn't we win that battle?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Yeah? And what do you call guys who win a battle but don't punish the losers?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The Allied Nations after World War 2?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: There was a sequel? I only saw the first one.
Everyone stares at Amanda for a moment.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Okay, I fell asleep halfway through.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Look... Maybe we don't do this for school pride... But that doesn't mean we don't have personal grudges!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Hector! What about that time when they egged everyone at your 'Hot Nurses and Spooky Curses' party?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Oh yeah! That sucked!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And Ben! What about that time they sabotaged your model volcano at the science fair?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That was them?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It had to be, right? A smart guy like you... No way you'd fail without sabotage!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Actually, I was really tired that day from fighting with Jessica... And I'm pretty sure I mixed the chemicals wrong...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It was Wilson, Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Those jerks!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Let's get them!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The what now?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Think about it, guys. When you look back on the last few years, what do you remember?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The days when you sat around in the cafeteria, doing nothing...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Or the days when you went out there and did something totally crazy and awesome?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I mean, Hector, don't you remember when we pranked Wilson so bad we got sent to Boot Camp... `And` we broke out of it?
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, Hector, don't you remember when we pranked Wilson so bad we got sent to Boot Camp... [color=#e23b3b][i]And[/i][/color] we broke out of it?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Heh... That `was` pretty great...
nodes.text_bbcode: Heh... That [color=#e23b3b][i]was[/i][/color] pretty great...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And Ben! Who would you be if you and Spencer hadn't totally taken Wilson down with that awesome badger prank?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That prank `made` you, man!
nodes.text_bbcode: That prank [color=#e23b3b][i]made[/i][/color] you, man!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: It `was` kind of a major life moment...
nodes.text_bbcode: It [color=#e23b3b][i]was[/i][/color] kind of a major life moment...

nodes.speaker: Howard

nodes.text: Yeah you do, baby!

nodes.text: Wait, which two?

nodes.text: I... I get it! I finally get it!

nodes.text: I know, but... I think I'm terrified of losing you!

nodes.speaker: Howard

nodes.text_bbcode: The thought of losing you, $ZOE... It scares me [color=#e23b3b][i]so much.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: You promise?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I love you.

At Wilson High!

And then a hand grabs his shoulder!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Hey! You're that punk that pranked graduation last year!
A crowd of Wilson guys circles around Howard, rolling up their sleeves and cracking their knuckles...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Is it too late to play the comical misunderstanding card?

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Oh yeah.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Aiiiiieeeeee!
Howard wasn't ready to move on from high school... But this can't be what he had in mind!
Try again, and see if you get him a happier ending!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I... I get it! I finally get it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Get what, Howard?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Why I keep feeling the way I do! I've spent all day doing awesome stuff, but it still didn't feel like the right way to say goodbye...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: But it's not high school I'm afraid of saying goodbye to. It's you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I'm okay having one last prank or one last game or one last drink of water at the good fountain... But I can't even begin to think about having one last date with you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But Howard... You don't have to. We're `not` breaking up.
nodes.text_bbcode: But Howard... You don't have to. We're [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] breaking up.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know, but... I think I'm terrified of losing you!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What if it doesn't work out? What if Centerscore U is too far? What if you meet someone else?
Howard turns away.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The thought of losing you, $ZOE... It scares me `so much.`
nodes.text_bbcode: The thought of losing you, $ZOE... It scares me [color=#e23b3b][i]so much.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, Howard...
$ZOE leans forward and hugs Howard from behind, pressing her face against his back...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You won't lose me. I promise.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I love you too much to ever let you go. We're `perfect` for each other. We're meant to be.
nodes.text_bbcode: I love you too much to ever let you go. We're [color=#3b78e2][i]perfect[/i][/color] for each other. We're meant to be.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We'll never have to say goodbye. Just 'see you soon.'
Howard turns back to $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You promise?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I promise.
Howard leans down and gives $ZOE a long, tender kiss...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I love you.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I love you too.
Wow! Looks like Howard finally figured out what his dream was trying to tell him... And he got the closure he needed! Great job!

nodes.text: On the night before his last day of school, Howard tosses and turns in his bed...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Uhhh... N... No...
And inside his mind...
He floats in a dark, shapeless void...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: This is... Kind of weird...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I recall the world being more... `Worldy...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I recall the world being more... [color=#e23b3b][i]Worldy...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Suddenly, he lands on solid ground! He looks around and finds himself on...
The football field!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh. Okay. The football field. That's cool. I like...
A ball appears in Howard's hands!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Football!
Jacob comes running up the field...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Hey! New kid!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Who? Me? No, I'm not the new...

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Yeah you, `meat!` You might think you're off the hook because you're friends with $USR... But I'm still watching you!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah you, [color=#e23b3b][i]meat![/i][/color] You might think you're off the hook because you're friends with $USR... But I'm still watching you!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: $USR... Man, that guy really fell off the grid...

nodes.speaker: Chuck
nodes.text: Yeah... We all do, sooner or later...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: We do?

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Hey! What are you waiting for, meat? Get the ball down the field! It's the big game with Wilson!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Right! Wilson! We hate those guys!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Yeah! I heard they eat babies!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That seems a little much...

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Don't mess this up, Howard! Everyone whose opinion you've ever cared about is in the stands, watching!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...Is that Suzie Gimball from first grade?

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: No time to gawk, meat! Go! Go like the meat you are!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Right!
Howard turns and sprints down the field! Vampire Wilson players rush from all sides!

nodes.speaker: Vampire Players
nodes.text: Blooooood...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Oh! What? Why? Why would that be a thing?!

nodes.speaker: Adam
nodes.text: Toss the ball, Howard! Toss it to the `team captain!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Toss the ball, Howard! Toss it to the [color=#e23b3b][i]team captain![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Right! The team captain during my freshman year! That would be...
